label: Local / small model
description: Four unambiguous single-argument tools plus the surface core. Avoids multi-step composition and large output.

descriptions.search_skills: Takes a plain query string. If nothing useful comes back, try one distinctive word rather than a sentence.
descriptions.read_skill: Takes one exact skill name, copied from a search result.
descriptions.get_file_tree: Takes a project name and max_entries of at least 10.
descriptions.skill_stats: No arguments. Use it to confirm the library is reachable.

guidance:
Four working tools are carried, all with simple arguments, plus the four that describe and change your own surface. Use them one at a time and do not chain steps speculatively.

`search_skills` takes a plain query string; if the first query returns nothing useful, try a single distinctive word rather than a sentence. `read_skill` takes one exact skill name copied from a search result. `get_file_tree` needs a project name and `max_entries` of at least 10.

The offset, grep and source tools are deliberately absent: they need careful arguments and produce large output. If you need one, `surface` with `list` shows what exists, and `pick` puts it on your surface.
workflow: skill_stats to confirm the library is reachable.
